title: fix: align Gen Workers promise rejection handling
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Enables Cloudflare’s documented microtask-checkpoint rejection behavior so caught AI SDK failures are not reported prematurely as unhandled.
- Updates only Gen’s Vitest Workers pool to the Vitest-3-compatible 0.12.21 release and resolves its workspace-local pool explicitly. Enter is unchanged.
- Removes two rejection-listener workarounds and fixes an existing validation test’s unstubbed request to gen.test. The large lockfile diff contains only Gen’s added dependency subtree.
- Separates the runtime/test prerequisite from #14360; no structured MCP output, registration, or adapter changes.
- Verified all 21 existing main agent tests, including JSON/SSE missing and malformed usage, with no unhandled-error or DNS diagnostics. Biome and diff checks pass. Not deployed.

Reference: [Cloudflare compatibility flag](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/configuration/compatibility-flags/#defer-unhandled-rejection-processing-to-after-microtask-checkpoint).

gist.headline: Rejections wait their turn
gist.blurb: Gen Workers now let a caught AI SDK error finish being caught before sounding the unhandled-error alarm. The bees have established a tiny, much calmer queue.
gist.summary: Gen Workers now enable Cloudflare's microtask-checkpoint rejection handling, update only Gen's Vitest Workers pool to 0.12.21, and remove two rejection-listener workarounds so caught AI SDK failures are handled correctly.
gist.impact: AI SDK validation paths, including malformed or missing JSON/SSE usage, now complete without premature unhandled-rejection or DNS diagnostics while retaining the existing agent behavior.
gist.visual_concept: Depict promise errors as tiny paper-message fireflies patiently waiting at a microtask checkpoint instead of setting off an alarm. Polli, wearing a small traffic-controller cap, guides them into an orderly queue beside a cozy Gen Worker terminal; a code-plant and flowers emphasize that reliable error handling helps the garden grow.
